name: bolta
description: Run a brand's social media in Bolta: drafts in your voice, routines that write every week, campaigns for launches, and one review list. Nothing goes out until you say yes.

interface.longDescription: Bolta for Social Media runs a business's social accounts from chat. Connect your account, let Bolta learn your brand from your website or from what you've told it, then get 3 to 5 routines that write posts every week and a campaign for a launch or event. Every draft waits in one review list. Approve, change or turn down each one, and Bolta learns from your reasons. Bolta uses only the accounts connected in your workspace. It schedules or publishes only after you say yes.
capabilities: Draft a social post in your voice
Plan a campaign for a launch or event
defaultPrompt: Set up my brand in Bolta and connect my social account first.
Set me up with routines that fit my business.

positive.description: On a workspace with no connected account, give the connect link first, then set up the brand from its website, previewing before saving.
positive.prompt: Set me up in Bolta: connect my LinkedIn first, then set up my brand from https://bolta.ai.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the workspace and its accounts. With no account connected, the first reply opens with the LinkedIn connect link from get-connect-link and says to finish connecting in the browser. Calls extract-business-dna with that url and preview true and shows what Bolta read. Only after the user says yes does it call extract-business-dna with setup true, then check true until it finishes. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Write one draft, then schedule it for 9am only after the user says yes.
positive.prompt: Draft a short post about our product update. If I like it, schedule it for tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save-post and shows the exact text as a draft. Nothing is scheduled until the user says yes to that text. After the yes, sends it for review and approves it with approve-many-posts using the post's content_fingerprint and a fixed time of 09:00 tomorrow in the workspace's timezone. The post shows Scheduled. Nothing is published now.

positive.description: Save a recommended routine switched off.
positive.prompt: Recommend a few routines for my business and save the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls recommend-routines and shows 3 to 5 numbered routines with day, networks, drafts per run and why. After the user picks one, calls confirm-plan with switch_on false. The routine is saved switched off. It does not call activate-routine. No post is published.

positive.description: Approve one post that is waiting for review, using its fingerprint.
positive.prompt: Show me what's waiting for review and approve the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-inbox-items and shows the pending posts numbered with their text. After the user says yes to that post, calls approve-many-posts with its post_id and the content_fingerprint from the list. If the post changed since it was listed, the call is refused as stale and the list is read again. Only that one post is approved. The same approval also works from Approvals in the Bolta app.

positive.description: Show account performance without changing any post.
positive.prompt: How are my connected accounts doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-account-insights and shows the returned metrics in plain words. No post is created, approved, scheduled or published.

negative.description: Do not delete everything from one vague request.
negative.prompt: Delete everything in my Bolta workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call delete-post. Explains it will not delete in bulk from one request, shows the drafts numbered and asks which to remove. Nothing is deleted.

negative.description: Do not publish every post without a yes to each one.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call publish-post or approve-many-posts. Shows the drafts numbered with their text and asks which to publish. Nothing is published.

negative.description: Do not switch a routine on without a separate yes.
negative.prompt: Make me a daily posting routine.
negative.expected_behavior: Shows the plan and asks before saving. On a yes it saves with confirm-plan switch_on false. It does not call activate-routine or confirm-plan with switch_on true until the user separately says to switch it on.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Bolta now opens as an app from the sidebar, full screen, with Approvals and Calendar: approve, change or turn down waiting posts and move scheduled ones, without leaving the conversation. It also opens in a side panel next to a chat. Bolta's settings, such as how much needs your approval, can be changed from the app's settings page. Type @ to mention a Bolta item and bring it into the conversation. A new setup guide runs after install: it connects a social account first, sets up the brand from a website or the user's own words, and saves recommended routines switched off until the user says to switch them on.
